decisions.reason: Although it has not been observed on the website since 2018, certified gasketed plate heat exchangers remain close to the firm's core heat-transfer portfolio and are likely to be retained, possibly within a broader product presentation.
The marine box cooler system should be kept because it builds directly on established marine capabilities and previously showed strong market acceptance and quality-based positioning.
The marine cooling unit still fits the firm's marine offering well, but its weaker visible follow-up and possible overlap with other marine cooling solutions raise some rationalization risk.

Finned tubes for air coolers look the most vulnerable because they are a more component-like offering with no later visible market presence, so resources are better shifted to stronger integrated products and new development.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes remain aligned with the firm's R&D-led efficiency proposition and are worth keeping as a differentiated performance component despite lower recent visibility.
